home.tagline: AI-powered Enterprise GHG (Scope 1, 2, 3) Integrated Management Platform

approvals.title: Approval Workflow
approvals.subtitle: The four-stage chain author to reviewer to approver to final sign-off, with digital signatures
approvals.sample_data_notice: The approval items and signatures below are samples, not real submissions or signing records.
approvals.signature_note: A signature verifies that the approved emission figure has not changed since sign-off. Without a configured signing key it proves integrity only, not signer authenticity.
approvals.rejected_note: A rejected item ends without the chain reaching 100%.
approvals.returned_note: A return for revision sends the item back to the author without closing the chain.

approval_comments.estimate_flagged: Use of an estimate recorded as a finding

suppliers.title: Supply Chain Supplier Portal
suppliers.subtitle: Supplier data submission, verification, rejection and re-request, with automatic Scope 3 roll-up
suppliers.sample_data_notice: The suppliers and submissions below are samples, not real trading partner data.
suppliers.aggregate_description: Only verified submissions feed reported Scope 3. Earlier requests replaced by a re-request are not double-counted.
suppliers.readonly_note: This screen is read-only for now. The verification, rejection and re-request logic exists in the library layer but is not yet wired to server actions.

supplier_rejection_reasons.no_methodology_disclosed: No calculation methodology disclosed, so unverifiable

scope3.title: Scope 3 Categories
scope3.subtitle: Relevance and calculation status of the 15 GHG Protocol value chain categories
scope3.sample_data_notice: The category definitions are the GHG Protocol standard, but the emission figures are sample data.
scope3.name: Category
scope3.quality_note: Data quality is an emissions-weighted average, so the quality of large categories dominates the score.
scope3.not_calculated_note: Not calculated is not zero. These categories were judged relevant but have no figure yet.
scope3.disclosure_note: The GHG Protocol requires companies to disclose the reason for every category judged not relevant.

scope3_category_descriptions.cat1: Production-stage emissions of purchased materials, components and services
scope3_category_descriptions.cat2: Production-stage emissions of capital goods such as equipment and buildings
scope3_category_descriptions.cat3: Fuel extraction and transport, plus grid losses, not already in Scope 1 or 2
scope3_category_descriptions.cat4: Inbound logistics for purchased goods and contracted distribution
scope3_category_descriptions.cat5: Treatment of waste generated at company operations
scope3_category_descriptions.cat6: Employee travel for business, including air, rail and accommodation
scope3_category_descriptions.cat7: Employee travel between home and the workplace
scope3_category_descriptions.cat8: Assets leased in by the company that are not already in Scope 1 or 2
scope3_category_descriptions.cat9: Post-sale distribution, storage and retail logistics
scope3_category_descriptions.cat10: Emissions from further processing of sold intermediate products by buyers
scope3_category_descriptions.cat11: Emissions arising during the use phase of sold products
scope3_category_descriptions.cat12: Disposal and recycling of sold products at end of life
scope3_category_descriptions.cat13: Operation of assets the company leases out to others
scope3_category_descriptions.cat14: Emissions from the operation of franchise outlets
scope3_category_descriptions.cat15: Attributed emissions of the investment and lending portfolio

scope3_exclusion_reasons.no_downstream_leases: The company leases no assets out to others.

ai.title: AI Analysis
ai.subtitle: Outlier, missing-data and abnormal-emissions detection results
ai.sample_data_notice: The emissions series under analysis is sample data, so the findings are illustrative too.
ai.anomalies_description: Detects distributional outliers by modified Z-score, implied emission factor anomalies, and sustained step changes.
ai.missing_description: Detects gaps in the monthly series, emission figures with no activity data, and unassessed Scope 3 categories.
ai.determinism_note: Every finding on this screen is a deterministic calculation and is reproducible. No generative model was used.
ai.model_not_configured: OPENAI_API_KEY is not set, so the generative features (abatement ideas, Q and A, report drafting) run on fallback logic.

findings.outlier_high: Emissions {value} tCO2e, {deviationPercent}% above the median of {median} tCO2e (modified Z-score {zScore})
findings.outlier_low: Emissions {value} tCO2e, {deviationPercent}% below the median of {median} tCO2e (modified Z-score {zScore})
findings.intensity_high: Implied factor {impliedFactor} per {unit}, {ratio} times the typical {typicalFactor}, so too high
findings.intensity_low: Implied factor {impliedFactor} per {unit}, {ratio} times the typical {typicalFactor}, so too low
findings.step_increase: Level shifted up {changePercent}%, from {from} tCO2e to {to} tCO2e, and stayed there
findings.step_decrease: Level shifted down {changePercent}%, from {from} tCO2e to {to} tCO2e, and stayed there
findings.missing_activity_data: Emissions of {emissions} tCO2e recorded with no activity data, so the figure cannot be recomputed or verified.
findings.scope3_not_assessed: Scope 3 category {category} has not been assessed for relevance yet.
findings.scope3_uncalculated: Scope 3 category {category} was judged relevant but has not been calculated yet.
